metadata.notes: 10-K/A (amended annual report) for FY2017 (calendar year ending Dec 31, 2017). This amends the original 10-K filed 2018-04-17. Reserves restated by Chapman Petroleum Engineering Ltd. as of January 1, 2018. Production of 2 MSTB crude oil (~2,000 bbls), zero gas production. Revenue of $155,161 from oil sales. Lease operating expense $252,753. Proved reserves restated: Oil 4,174 MSTB, Gas 8,353 MMCF (header labeled MCF but values consistent with MMCF given context). Total proved reserves ~5,566 MBOE. All proved undeveloped reserves = 4,174 MSTB oil and 8,353 MMCF gas. Standardized measure $25,700,686. Significant revision from original 10-K (was $56.96MM). Extensions and discoveries of 4,174 MSTB oil and 8,353 MCF gas added, offset by downward revisions of 1,620 MSTB oil and 811 MCF gas.
